# David Johnson

David Johnson is the current Connétable of [St Mary](https://flow.je/elections/st-mary) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2014.

David Johnson has participated in 5 elections since 2002:

- [**2008 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/david-johnson#e12)

  Not elected.
- [**2011 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/david-johnson#e15)

  Not elected.

  - [2011 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20110928162441/http://www.channel103.com:80/election/?page_id=99)
- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/david-johnson#e20)

  Elected as Deputy of St Mary with 54.5% of the vote.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/david-johnson-3/)
- [**2018 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/david-johnson#e42)

  Elected as Deputy of St Mary with 60.7% of the vote.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/david-johnson-2/)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=61qEfRxBYoQ)
- [**2022 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/david-johnson#e49)

  Elected as Connétable of St Mary with 54.1% of the vote.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/david-johnson/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ihKIjXCQC_0)

David Johnson has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Connétables Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [St Mary](https://flow.je/elections/st-mary). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/12/contest-for-constable-looms-in-smallest-parish/)\]

## Election History

### 2008 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Mary](https://flow.je/elections/st-mary) (1 seat), 26th November 2008.

**David Johnson was not elected**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Daniel Wimberley](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/daniel-wimberley)** |  | 261 | 52.7% |
| 2 | David Johnson |  | 206 | 41.6% |
| 3 | [David Richardson](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/david-richardson) |  | 28 | 5.7% |

495 votes

1,139 registered voters

= 43.5% turnout
